label: For "Workforce Productivity & FTE Leakage Detection": Detect unexplained variance between staffed hours, workload, service volume and approved budgets, and queue it as an investigation lead with an estimated financial exposure and no allegation attached. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Calling a data gap a leakage finding.
